page_title: AUG 1-1 HOF | Augsburg v Hoffenheim 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Iago (Augsburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him.
90+6' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:6.
90+4' The substitution has been made. Dion Beljo has replaced Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg).
90+4' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Phillip Tietz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).
90+2' Iago (Augsburg) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Maximilian Beier comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bambase Conte (Hoffenheim).
89' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

89' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Oliver Baumann. This effort really didn't trouble him.
87' The attendance for today's match is 22000.
84' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
83' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) will be replaced by Kevin Mbabu.
82' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

82' Augsburg have a corner. Great save! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Oliver Baumann.
81' 40:60 – the ratio of ball possession.
77' Flag goes up against Iago (Augsburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
76' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Arne Engels (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.
76' Substitution. Iago (Augsburg) has come on for Mads Pedersen.
76' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
76' Julian Justvan (Hoffenheim) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
73' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
70' Here is a change. Finn Ole Becker is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
70' Here comes a substitution. Julian Justvan (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Ihlas Bebou.
69' The fouls committed statistics – 5:9.
65' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.
63' The match can continue after the interruption.
59' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
56' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
55' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.

53' 1 - 1 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Oliver Baumann had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:1.
53' 2:5 – the corner kicks stats.

50' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his low strike to the middle of the target as Finn Dahmen produces a good save.
49' A cross from a corner kick by Hoffenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
49' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Hoffenheim win a corner.
47' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Felix Brych blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Felix Brych and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' A player from Hoffenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
42' Corner kicks – 2:4.
39' Great chance! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
37' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
35' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Brych has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Rough tackle by Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:6.
27' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Augsburg, play can continue.
26' There's a break in play and referee Felix Brych must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Augsburg using VAR. This could be interesting!
25' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

23' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Marius Bulter finds Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Finn Dahmen had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
23' Hoffenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
18' The possession of the ball – 27:73.
14' A spell of possession for Hoffenheim in an attempt to control the game.
13' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
11' A clumsy foul by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) and Felix Brych blows his whistle.
9' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
7' None of the Augsburg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
6' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
6' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick, but Finn Dahmen reads it well and stops the effort.
4' Felix Brych blows his whistle and it's Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
1' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Felix Brych will supervise the game today.
